definition: II. שְׁתִי 8 noun masculine warp (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic , id. ); — always ׳ שׁ absolute; — warp , the set of threads drawn lengthwise in loom, through which the shuttle bearing the woof (II. עֵרֶב ) is thrown crosswise; Lev 13:48 + 7 t. Lev 13 compare GFM PAOS, Oct. 1889, cixxviii ARSK EB WEAVING . שָׁתוֺת see [ שָׁת ] below שׁית . שְׁתַּיִם see שְׁנַיִם below II. שׁנה .

שָׁתוֺת see [ שָׁת] below שׁית.
